name: Hitman World of Assassination: 25th Anniversary Edition
summary:
Celebrate 25 years of Hitman with the Anniversary Box of Hitman World of Assassination, featuring exclusive collectibles:
- “Chess Master” 3D Shadowbox. No one is out of reach for Agent 47. With the iconic ICA19 Silverballer in his hands, he awaits his next assignment in this exclusive Shadowbox.
- “25 Years of Hitman" Lenticular card. From Hitman: Codename 47 to Hitman World of Assassination, this art card pays tribute to the evolution of Agent 47.
- Hitman World of Assassination (25th Anniversary graphics). Includes the best of Hitman, Hitman 2, and Hitman 3, featuring the main campaign, contracts mode escalations, freelancer mode, and live content.
- Celebrity Elusive Target DLCs. Includes The Undying, The Drop, The Splitter, The Banker packs that unlock a series of cosmetics inspired by the Elusive Targets and give permanent access to the missions.
